title: National Science Medals
text: I built the site’s frontend and the interactive laureate explorer for the National Science and Technology Medals Foundation. The WebGL experience presented medal recipients in a visual timeline, with filters that let visitors narrow the collection. It gave people a way to explore scientific achievement through the people behind it, alongside the wider website’s laureate profiles and stories. The foundation’s launch letter described the timeline as part of that effort to bring laureates’ lives and contributions into public view. My frontend and explorer work helped make the collection available to the public online.
summary: I built the site’s frontend and the interactive laureate explorer for the National Science and Technology Medals Foundation, giving visitors a visual way to explore medal recipients and their achievements.
